descricao: Explain any topic like I'm 5: a dead-simple HTML picture explainer with big visuals and few words. Use /eli5 <topic>.
Give an agent video evidence: timestamped frames and native captions, with optional local WhisperX or Groq/OpenAI transcription.
Design fluency for frontend development. 1 skill with 24 commands (/impeccable polish, /impeccable audit, /impeccable critique, etc.) and curated anti-pattern detection.
Lazy senior dev mode. Forces the simplest, shortest solution that actually works: YAGNI, stdlib first, no unrequested abstractions.

Skins for Claude Code: tool rows that open onto their input and answer, highlighted code, diff, table, math, Mermaid and shell cards, links, folding, a usage band, a calm mode and fifteen themes. /skin swaps them live.
Painel para ver, ligar, desligar, instalar e agrupar em perfis os seus mods e plugins.
One quiet line above the prompt: context, 5-hour and weekly usage, whether the prompt cache is warm, and a Clear & continue button.
Prateleira de ideias por projeto: anote ideias num painel e marque como feitas; fica salvo em IDEAS.md na raiz do projeto.
A side chat pane inside the session that answers questions or runs requests on a model of your choice.
